messages:
Jules: heads-up: eu-west2 batch launches started failing with GPU attach timeouts ~06:14. saw a spike in local-ssd iowait across a subset of hosts.
Priya: which hosts? any SMART or nvme errors?
Jules: sampled gnode-eu-21-07, gnode-eu-21-09, gnode-eu-22-01. kernel logs show increasing writeback stalls and some nvme controller warnings.
Jules: ```
[ 2456.321000] nvme0: controller busy, retrying command
[ 2456.322100] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 1234567
[ 2457.000500] fstrim: delayed discard completion; writeback stalled
```
Ken: timeline note: last night we ramped tempfile janitor concurrency and a new scrub scheduling tweak landed in eu-west2 at 02:00. could be overlapping.
Priya: load graph shows scrub IOPS + janitor delete spikes aligning with attach failures. concurrency at 8 for scrubber. that's likely the pressure point.
Jules: immediate plan: 1) reduce scrub concurrency to 2 in eu-west2, 2) suspend tempfile-jobs for 15m, 3) shift non-pinned attaches to eu-west1 for 30m.
Ken: agree. also lower per-node janitor threadpool to avoid writeback storms. doing commands now.
Ken: ```
kubectl -n storage set env daemonset/scrubber SCRUB_CONCURRENCY=2 --context=prod-eu-west2
kubectl -n janitor patch cronjob/tempfile-sweep -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}' --context=prod-eu-west2
kubectl -n janitor set env deployment/janitor JANITOR_THREADS=2 --context=prod-eu-west2
```
ops-bot: scrubber concurrency updated; tempfile-sweep CronJob suspended; janitor threads set to 2.
deploy-bot: routing policy updated: prefer eu-west1 for non-pinned attaches for 30m.
Jules: quick signal: pending attaches reduced from ~95 -> 28 in 90s, iowait trending down.
Priya: follow-ups: run nondestructive nvme verify on the impacted hosts, and open vendor case for the controller firmware (cohort might be same SKU). also add a guard to prevent simultaneous deep-scrub + janitor on a node-level.
Ken: I'll author the small RB to gate scrub by node iowait and add a controller flag to avoid concurrent maintenance in same AZ.
Jules: if verify shows increasing media errors we'll mark those gnodes for replacement. tagging infra-oncall. :white_check_mark:
Priya: thanks — will update after verification.
